mintAuthority.summary: OUSG native issuance is reviewed across Ethereum, Polygon, Solana, and XRPL. Ethereum has active OUSG_InstantManager and Ondo Safe MINTER_ROLE holders plus their administrators; Polygon's proxy-admin Safe can replace mint logic even with no current MINTER_ROLE holder; Solana's mint authority and the XRPL issuer account can issue OUSG directly. No bridge representation or transfer-rail authority is included in Mint Authority.

upgradeability.controlRef: Ondo 4-of-7 Safe (OUSG token DEFAULT_ADMIN and MINTER_ROLE[1])

controls.label: OUSG_InstantManager
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770414, the OUSG token has two current MINTER_ROLE holders, including 0x93358db73B6cd4b98D89c8F5f230E81a95c2643a (the InstantManager). Ondo docs confirm this contract handles instant buy/redeem.

controls.label: Ondo 4-of-7 Safe (OUSG token DEFAULT_ADMIN and MINTER_ROLE[1])

sources.label: Ondo OUSG token getRoleMember at Ethereum block 25295096

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770414, getRoleMember(MINTER_ROLE, 1) returned 0xAEd4caF2E535D964165B4392342F71bac77e8367 and DEFAULT_ADMIN getRoleMember(0) also returned this address. Safe API confirmed the current 4-of-7 owner set, version 1.3.0, no enabled modules, and zero guard.

controls.label: Ondo 3-of-5 Safe (OUSG_InstantManager admin)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770414, DEFAULT_ADMIN on OUSG_InstantManager resolves to 0x5AE21c99FC5f1584D8Cb09a298CFFd92B5d178eF. Safe API confirmed the current 3-of-5 owner set, version 1.4.1, no enabled modules, and zero guard.

controls.label: Ondo 3-of-6 Safe (OUSG Polygon ProxyAdmin owner)
controls.evidence: At Polygon block 92141177, the OUSG proxy resolves to implementation 0xf0001671af432f7bb3c3172608265e49722fdbbb and EIP-1967 admin 0xa4d0c86e1186088beebf1f72f2a4aaba92ade0e. That ProxyAdmin is owned by the Ondo 3-of-6 Safe 0x4413073440A568790c1b2b06B47F7D0a443574d0; the Safe API confirmed six owners, threshold 3, no enabled modules, and zero guard. The token currently has no MINTER_ROLE holder, but this upgrade path can replace mint logic.

controls.label: OUSG Solana mint authority
controls.evidence: At finalized Solana slot 439722065, the OUSG SPL mint i7u4r16TcsJTgq1kAG8opmVZyVnAKBwLKu6ZPMwzxNc has mint authority 6ViaRWzv7p56RfP1A9Hxy2ctu9kfE3XL43SxWuq3E4cE and zero reported supply. The mint authority can create native OUSG units; freeze authority remains a separate blacklist/pause control.

controls.label: OUSG XRPL issuer account
controls.evidence: At XRPL validated ledger 106341875, issuer rHuiXXjHLpMP8ZE9sSQU5aADQVWDwv6h5p has Domain set to ondo.finance and issues the OUSG currency identified by the XRPL currency code. The issuer account can create native issued-currency units; RequireAuth and AllowTrustLineClawback remain issuer controls in their own module.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770414, OUSG token MINTER_ROLE has two holders: OUSG_InstantManager (0x93358db7) and the 4-of-7 Ondo Safe (0xAEd4caF2); the InstantManager's DEFAULT_ADMIN is a separate current 3-of-5 Safe. Ethereum and Polygon transparent-proxy paths can replace mint-critical logic, with the Polygon ProxyAdmin owned by a current 3-of-6 Ondo Safe. Solana's mint authority 6ViaRWzv7p56RfP1A9Hxy2ctu9kfE3XL43SxWuq3E4cE and the XRPL issuer account rHuiXXjHLpMP8ZE9sSQU5aADQVWDwv6h5p are additional native issuance authorities. These controls are canonical Mint Authority; no bridge representation authority is counted here. Safe APIs confirmed the current owner sets, thresholds, no enabled modules, and zero guards. Economic-control evidence reviewed 2026-07-15: NAV Consulting has direct read-only access, independently calculates OUSG NAV, and publishes full fund financial data daily with up to a three-day lag. The current offering document states that the OUSG fund is not registered under the Investment Company Act; adviser registration does not qualify as product prudential supervision. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-16: native minting remains unbounded, daily independent NAV reporting remains periodic, and no product prudential supervision is established.
